entities.name: Higure
entities.description: A human master ninja of Kamigawa during the Kami War, orphaned as a child and trained at the Temple of the Black Scroll.

entities.name: Kagero
entities.description: Higure's master, who named him Higure.

entities.name: Nitta
entities.description: A samurai merchant living in seclusion, marked for assassination.

entities.name: Kio
entities.description: Nitta's daughter, whom Higure had loved from afar.

entities.name: Temple of the Black Scroll
entities.description: Where Higure was trained as a ninja.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: The war during which Higure was active.

events.summary: Higure's village was attacked by malevolent kami, leaving him sole survivor of his family.
events.quote: recalling the night when his village was attacked by malevolent kami, leaving him as the sole survivor of his family

events.summary: Master Kagero named him Higure, 'twilight', and 'the Still Wind'.
events.quote: He was named Higure, meaning "twilight," by his master, Kagero.

events.summary: Higure led his disciples to infiltrate Nitta's villa to assassinate the merchant, his guards and heir.
events.quote: Higure led his disciples on a mission to infiltrate the villa of Nitta

events.summary: Higure and his disciples eliminated a lone guard and Nitta's daughter Kio without alerting the household.
events.quote: Higure encountered a lone guard and Nitta's daughter Kio

relations.quote: his early training under Master Kagero
The target was the merchant, his guards, and his heir, who were marked for assassination.
